page_description: How shoppers browse: a tree of categories. A product can be in any number of them, and a category lists its subcategories' products too.
empty_description: Add one, then put products in it from its page or from a product's page.
add_handle_description: Its address in the storefront: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Unique across categories.
visibility_hidden_description: The storefront doesn't show it yet.
visibility_description: Hiding it hides everything below it too.
name_description: Shown to shoppers in menus and on its page.
handle_description: Its address in the storefront. Moving it keeps it.
description_hint: For the category page and search engines.
image_hint: Shown on the category page and in menus. It can't be deleted from the library while it's here.
products_hint: The ones directly in it. The storefront lists its subcategories' products too.
picker_description: They're listed directly in this category.
delete_description: Its products stay; they just leave this category. A category with subcategories can't be deleted until they're moved or deleted.
